newsitem.title: UK: Copper around highs in late LME, mulls Escondida.
newsitem.headline: Copper around highs in late LME, mulls Escondida.

text.p: Copper prices hardly moved during Monday evening LME inter-office trading, with the market still in a cautious mood over the strike at Chile's Escondida mine.
Analysts said the stoppage is an underpinning factor, although it is unclear what impact the strike by some of the workforce is having.

"...the unions have been reported as saying that production has been reduced to 20 percent, however, further confirmation of this has yet to emerge," brokerage Rudolf Wolff and Co said in its daily report.
The other factor helping copper was a widening in the cash/threes backwardation to $59/64 today from $45/50 last Friday.
At 1900 local three months copper was quoted at $2,290/2,293 a tonne, while aluminium was indicated at $1,555/1,557.
